integrity: All mathematical assertions are supplied with an explicit all-field proof. An executable standalone finite-field checker provides independent arithmetic examples but not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: All fields must have characteristic two, the matrix is 3-by-3 and has an irreducible cubic characteristic polynomial. Finite cardinality and Singer action require a finite field. Generalization to reducible matrices or larger degrees is not proved. Independent audit not performed. Historical priority risk: an implicit enumerative variant in older rank-one perturbation literature may exist.
title: Tripotent–square-zero fibers of irreducible cubic matrices in characteristic two
